title: Location Scout Checklist
subtitle: Visit all 5 Director Mode locations in Los Santos & Blaine County.

items.name: Legion Square
items.locationText: Downtown central plaza near Maze Bank Tower.
items.details: Enter Director Mode and warp or drive to Legion Square.

items.name: Del Perro Pier
items.locationText: End of the wooden boardwalk next to the Ferris Wheel.
items.details: Walk all the way to the oceanfront deck.

items.name: Vinewood Sign
items.locationText: Top of the Mount Haan ridge directly behind the letter D.
items.details: Best accessed via helicopter or driving up the dirt path.

items.name: Mount Chiliad Peak
items.locationText: Cable car observation deck at the peak.
items.details: Step onto the viewing platform overlooking the Alamo Sea.

items.name: Paleto Bay Beach
items.locationText: Northernmost coast near the cable car station.
items.details: Walk along the shoreline to trigger location discovery.
